en.title: Minimum Remaining Fruits After Eliminating Pairs of Different Types
en.description:
In each step, pick one fruit from each of two different types and delete both; they do not need to be adjacent. You cannot delete a pair of the same type. Find the minimum number of fruits left.

This site independently compiled the standard I/O and editorial; additions for bounds missing from the sources and corrections to examples are stated explicitly in the protocol.
en.input: The first line contains n and the second line contains n type integers. The original bounds are 1≤n≤100000, 1≤type≤10^9.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The outputs of the three public examples are 1; 0; and 2, checked by independent enumeration or direct simulation.
hints: Let f be the highest frequency; the answer is max(2f−n,n%2).
